title: Reassessment of Embedded Derivatives
summary: Clarified when an entity must reassess whether an embedded derivative should be separated from its host contract. Withdrawn in 2010 and its guidance absorbed directly into IFRS 9.

related.title: Financial Instruments
related.relationship: The current standard, absorbing IFRIC 9's reassessment logic directly

related.title: Financial Instruments: Recognition and Measurement
related.relationship: The predecessor financial instruments standard IFRIC 9 originally supported

related.title: Business Combinations
related.relationship: Governs the business combination context relevant to IFRIC 9's acquisition-date exclusion
